name: desk-board
description: A live board of bork do runs in Claude Code: what is in motion, what waits on you, what finished. A press on a run switches herdr to its tab.

terminalApp.title: Terminal app bundle id
terminalApp.description: macOS bundle id of the terminal that shows herdr (for example com.mitchellh.ghostty). A press then also raises that app. Leave empty to only switch the herdr tab.
